notes.title: Update 5 is out!
notes.content:
Dear players, new update 5 is here 
* All maps in new visual quality
* Engine update
* New linear lighting
* New postprocess 
* New better water and many many more. 

Changes and new features based on community reports: 
* Full controller support
* New visibility system
* No falling into the water and similar frustration
* Crosshair 
* Tank speed depend on damage and more.

notes.content:
* New two weapons:
Heavy 125mm cannon - really heavy cannon.
EMP Cannon - cannon with EMP projectile. 
Enemy tank is unusable next 4 seconds after the explosion.

* Weapons balancing: Damage / Reload time / Price.

* Several bugs fixed.
